claim_reviews.conclusion: A material contrast exists: Indonesian menemui commonly means meet, visit, encounter, or in some contexts find; Malaysian menemui likewise strongly carries meet/visit senses, so using it unqualified for “to find” can mislead learners.
claim_reviews.subject: False-friend contrast

rationale: Indonesian menemukan correctly expresses “to find” as obtain/discover. Malaysian menemui has a dictionary sense of finding, but its primary learner-relevant senses include meeting, visiting, or encountering a person; Malaysian Malay uses menemukan more clearly for finding something sought. Presenting menemui as the straightforward Malaysian equivalent creates a material false-friend risk.
